name: Makita DUC254Z
blurb: Oregon prints one chain under DUC254Z: 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .043″ gauge, 40 drive links (R40).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Makita DUC254Z on its own line with chain R40: 10″ bar, 40 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. R40 is the .043″ low-profile retail code. The DUC303, DUC353 and DUC400 are a different manual and a different page. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints R40 directly under Makita DUC254Z: 10″ bar, 40 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
